description: Replaces the cards the track's sheet shows in the app (call get_glance first to keep the ones it has). Each card is {label, value, detail, group, tone, link}; any of them can be a sheet formula starting with =, so the sheet works out the number and whether it's good, warn or bad. A card that turns warn or bad notifies the person. Formulas can't use IMPORT functions, IMAGE, HYPERLINK or WEBSERVICE. read_guide page glance has examples.

cards.description: The whole list, 0 to 50 cards, in the order they show. An empty list removes them all.

detail.description: One line under it, like "left of $200".

group.description: Cards with the same group show together under it.

link.description: add (the sheet's form, answers after ?, like add?category=Dining), todo, sheet, or sheet?tab=Name.

tone.description: good, warn, bad or plain, or a formula giving one.

value.description: The number, usually a formula, like =SUMIFS(Transactions!D:D, Transactions!C:C, "Dining").

name: set_glance
title: Set a track's Glance cards
